def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    face_value = 100.0
    annual_coupon_rate = 0.05
    coupon_payment = face_value * annual_coupon_rate
    z_spread = 0.0234
    spot_rates = [0.0486, 0.0495, 0.0565]
    
    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    bond_value = 0.0
    
    for year, spot_rate in enumerate(spot_rates, start=1):
        discount_rate = spot_rate + z_spread
        cash_flow = coupon_payment
        
        if year == len(spot_rates):
            cash_flow += face_value
        
        bond_value += cash_flow / ((1 + discount_rate) ** year)
    
    # return answer
    return round(bond_value, 3)
